title: Separate app/backend/web repos with backend-owned contracts and generated public API boundary
Agent runtime in Cloudflare Durable Objects; health data in Supabase Postgres
Gemma 4 27B (CF Workers AI) for ~95% of LLM calls; Claude Sonnet 4.6 reserved for ~5% pattern analysis
All LLM traffic routes through Cloudflare AI Gateway with a single project-scoped key
Memory blocks are typed into 5 halls (`facts` / `events` / `discoveries` / `preferences` / `advice`), not a flat key-value table
Tools never write to `memory_blocks` directly; they stage to `memory_inbox` and the Scribe applies on a nightly merge
Episodes older than 90 days move from DO SQLite to Cloudflare R2 JSONL archive; pgvector in Supabase handles semantic recall beyond that
Tools are scoped per trigger type via a static ACL map; no trigger gets all 13 tools
Hard cap of 3 proactive pushes per user per day, enforced in DO `daily_push_budget` table
HealthKit Background Delivery (with `HKAnchoredObjectQuery` anchors) is the sanctioned 24/7 stress-detection path on iOS, not polling
CRS algorithm is grounded in SAFTE-FAST (US Army fatigue research), not derived from OURA-style readiness
Channel priority: Telegram (grammY) and APNs/FCM for V1; WhatsApp deferred to Phase 2
Chat renders inline rich cards (Generative UI), not plain text only
Waldo can inject new messages into existing chat threads when new biological data is relevant to that thread's topic
Single `brief` trigger type with a `variant` field, replacing `morning_wag` as the canonical trigger
Two-tier subscription pricing: Pup (free) · Pro $14.99/mo (soft caps) · Pro Max $29.99/mo (uncapped usage)
Patrol pass cadence: every 15 minutes during waking hours, plus an explicit pre-Brief sweep 30 minutes before each Brief variant
The Adjustment autonomy enforcement: L1 = never act, L2 = propose with one-tap, L3 = auto + Patrol audit
The Window scheduling decision rules: Form-driven trigger conditions, three durations, autonomy-gated via ADR-0018
The Intervention: composite trigger (Form floor + Load ceiling + complex-task signal + 3-Patrol-entry pattern), 2h cooldown with Form-drop override, learning in `hall_advice`

Copilot tool surface expansion: 7 new tools (write_task, update_task, draft_document, draft_email, propose_schedule, write_sheet_cell, execute_code) + search_connector reclassified to tool, all gated by ADR-0018 autonomy + ADR-0008 ACL

Skill system architecture: 15 bundled system skills (immutable), connector skills (auto-loaded), user/agent-authored skills (mutable in R2), agentskills.io-compatible markdown shape, rule-based + nightly LLM-judge effectiveness scoring
`execute_code` primitive backed by Cloudflare Sandbox SDK: Python + JS, 30s hard timeout, empty egress allowlist by default, Scribe-sanitised stdout/stderr before model sees results

Scribe sanitiser canonical spec: rule-based PII strip + health value lockout + canary token check + size cap, applied to memory writes / sandbox stdout / draft document body / skill bodies / inbox merge — single seam

DocAdapter contract: unified read/search/write across Drive + Notion + Confluence + R2-scratch, with `parent_folder_id` normalised to opaque string, search returning `Hit[]` with title+url+snippet+date, write returning `{ doc_id, url }` and idempotency_key

SheetProvider contract: normalised A1 range syntax across Sheets + Excel/Graph, idempotent cell writes with `commit_hash`, read returns typed cells with formatting metadata, write always-confirms (connector_write rule)

EmailProvider drafts extension: Gmail + Outlook drafts API only (never sends from Waldo), unified MIME-builder, body sanitised by Scribe before provider, send_draft becomes its own user-tap-only execute_action invocation

Skill loader + REASONS Canvas integration: 5-stage filter pipeline, top-K (default 5) by effectiveness, skill body slotted into A (Approach) layer wrapped in `<available-skills>` tag, ACL pre-check + recall-before-act wiring
Backend-owned workspace contract spine: waldo-backend/packages/contracts exports internal Zod/TS schemas and emits public OpenAPI/JSON-Schema clients; published waldo-types package path retired

Verification layer: 4-component eval stack (LLM-judge with calibrated rubrics + Waldo Improvement Score + trace-native production eval + memory eval harness with Recall@K/MRR), Phase E starts, Phase G is the deep instrumentation

Recall-before-act explicit wiring: deterministic memory retrieval injected into every invocation's prompt as `<recall>` block, queries all 5 halls + episodes + agent_evolutions in parallel, fails open (no recall = no blocker), shipped Sprint 1

Hooks-based safety layers: 7 zero-token middleware hooks (PreToolUse · PostToolUse · PrePromptBuild · PostPromptBuild · PreLLMCall · PostLLMCall · OnError) running deterministically around every invocation, independent traversal (no shared bottleneck), audit log + rate limit + sanitiser + JWT + canary as hook implementations

Session trust reset on every DO alarm wake: memory persists, permissions reset, canary tokens regenerated, ACL rebuilt from TOOL_PERMISSIONS[triggerType], deny-first invariant — no prior-session authorisation ever carries forward

Tool output compression (37% token reduction) + lazy tool discovery via `search_tools(query)` first-class tool (85% token reduction for large registries), both implemented as hooks per ADR-0032, sanitiser runs BEFORE compression (priority 100 → 200) — combined ~50%+ token savings on tool-heavy invocations

Channel persona slicing: same underlying agent + memory, channel-specific context slice + tone modifier + UI affordances — Telegram (personal, full memory, inline buttons), APNs/iOS (structured cards, display-optimised), Slack/Discord/in-app (work context, filtered, redacted health data per workspace rules)

Background Learning Agent — separate from Dreaming Mode, fires on 3 triggers (10-turn conversation rollup · 15-iteration tool-sequence detection · 4-AM multi-day inactivity deep analysis), writes to memory_inbox via Scribe, no user-facing surface, Phase G

Append-only event log (agent_logs immutable, no UPDATE/DELETE allowed) + stable `pattern_id` on memory_blocks (md5(normalize(claim) + sorted_conditions)[:12]) — enables superseded_by chains, rejection_count tracking, decision audit logs, rollback as production capability per ai-agent-ecosystem takeaway 29

RBAO (Ratchet-Based Autonomous Optimisation) + WIS (Waldo Improvement Score) instrumentation: instrument in Phase D-E, activate ratchet in Phase G, immutable baseline = soul files + CRS algorithm + safety rules, mutation zone = behavioural parameters + skill effectiveness weights, single canonical metric (WIS), git-style keep-or-revert per experiment, never optimises identity

Chat threading model: persistent threads (NOT day-bound), grouped-by-topic in list, message-level soft delete + recovery, branching via parent_message_id + branch_depth, expand/collapse driven by branch_depth, four new-thread entry points (chat list / Overview swipe / long-press card / "Talk about this with Waldo" button), topic classification rule-based first → LLM fallback
CalendarProvider moves from Phase 2 to Phase 1
Voice memo pipeline — Phase 1 user-initiated audio → memory
`pre_activity_spot` trigger — calendar-aware proactive Spot before high-stakes meetings
Cross-Session Bus for Multi-Developer, Multi-Machine, Multi-Repo Claude Code Work

External truth invalidates memory: deterministic trust-class priority (system-of-record > user-stated > committed memory > provisional inbox > LLM inference), supersedence executed only through the Scribe seam on the bi-temporal model, point-in-time recall for superseded blocks, and the "Waldo updated its understanding" surfacing rule
General-agent tools (`web_search`, `read_document`, `call_mcp_tool`) ship in V1
`execute_code` deferred to Phase 3; removed from V1 tool permissions
Tier-aware spend cap, decoupled from the abuse circuit-breaker
DO-only agent runtime; L1 `invoke-agent` removed; service-role key off the agent loop
Agent-Native Dev-Loop — SessionStart context hook + @pin4sf/agent-rules sync package + 3-layer enforcement stack
Durable agent execution: a per-run state journal + transactional outbox in DO SQLite, keyed by run identity (not a time bucket)
GDPR deletion runbook must enumerate every store that holds personal or derived-health data, not just the three primary ones
DO SQLite compaction & lifecycle: per-table retention, archive-don't-delete to R2, single federated retrieval path
In-context working memory: capped carryover buckets that survive compaction and crash-resume
Per-tier recovery posture: Supabase PITR (health SoR) + Durable Object SQLite PITR (built-in, 30-day, per-object) + R2/outbox for the longer horizon
Two Supabase access paths, not one pooler: user-scoped reads via PostgREST/supabase-js (HTTPS, JWT→RLS); Supavisor transaction pooling only for raw service/admin SQL
A fixed Supabase platform-hardening baseline as a launch gate — and the one real trade-off: Network Restrictions cover all DB routes but not the HTTPS APIs, vs Cloudflare's dynamic egress
Range-partition the high-volume Postgres tables by month (pg_partman) — decided now because the partition key must be in the PRIMARY KEY, which is near-impossible to retrofit on a billion-row table
Database-tier observability + published SLOs, reusing the existing OTel/Sentry stack — and the constraint that makes it non-trivial: the log/metric pipeline is itself a PHI surface
Canonical Rule Files in waldo-brain, Mirrored Verbatim to Code Repos
Persistent goals (GoalRecord) + skill Curator-lifecycle fields — contract now, loop later
DO alarm multiplexer and fleet liveness
DO→Supabase per-user RLS JWT custody

ADR-0068 — Canonical delivery-policy table (push-budget composition)
ADR-0069 — Model roster + routing policy v1 + shadow-eval harness
WIS / keep-rate per-channel engagement contract
V1 Scope Cut — Brief + shadow-Fetch + Spots + Chat; nine deferrals with re-entry criteria
The Fetch ships shadow-first behind a measured false-positive bar
Compliance regime — GDPR-as-baseline engineering, EU/EEA/UK excluded for beta, DPDP-aware
Loop Governor — deterministic cross-loop governance seam
Connector-OAuth token custody (Copilot write-surface)

Conversation spaces, nested threading, context pins, health bundles, and replay
Memory edges activation graph
Prospective commitments as explicit memory
